stories.title: Cool adaptations: How fish survive in the Antarctic Ocean
stories.summary: With water temperatures as low as -1.9°C (28.6°F), the Southern Ocean is a place of extreme living conditions. A new study led by Senckenberg researchers shows how fish have adapted to Antarctic temperatures. The researchers used the Antarctic spiny plunderfish (Harpagifer antarcticus) as a model organism and, for the first time, analyzed the maternal and paternal copies of its genome separately. This allowed them to uncover mechanisms that contribute to this group of fishes' adaptation to extreme cold.

The former army chief was tasked with forming a government by the president, after he received the backing of 67 members of the 120-seat Knesset, compared to 46 for Netanyahu. He has 28 days to build a coalition, with a possible two-week extension.

So your phone moving from Wi-Fi to mobile data is usually a sign that something went wrong with your Wi-Fi connection.

stories.title: Claude Code is accidentally exposing secrets all over GitHub
stories.summary: Do not ask again" prompt leads to passwords, API keys, and more being shared. The leak stems from the way Claude Code handles user approval for automated shell commands. When a user chooses the “Yes, and don’t ask again” option to approve running a command, that choice gets stored as part of a rule in the local “.claude/settings.local.json” file on the user’s computer. That rule is sometimes coded as a pattern, but the command itself is often written to that settings file as is, including any sensitive information that may be embedded within it.

Hand sanitiser sales were up 83%, sales of bottled water rose 67% and tinned and jarred goods climbed 37%, according to data from retail research firm Worldpanel by Numerator. The government's public awareness campaign encouraged people to stock up in case of disruption to essential services by severe weather or cyberattacks.

Syracuse led for much of the first half but Indiana took control in the second. Trailing by three with less than five seconds left, Syracuse forced a turnover in its full-court press and earned a chance to tie the game. Kiyan Anthony forced a deep three that went awry and Indiana secured the victory.

stories.summary: We now know the kickoff time for the Trojans' final home game of the regular season On Monday, the Big Ten announced the kickoff time for the matchup. USC-Maryland will kick off at 3:15 p.m. Pacific time and air on Big Ten Network. Every team in the league is required to play at least one conference game on Big Ten Network. Given that USC had not yet fulfilled that requirement yet and the Trojans ' other November contests are all against top ten opponents, the Maryland game being on BTN had felt inevitable for several weeks now. The question was merely what time the game would kick off—a question that has now been answered.
